mapper.select: SELECT id, hourly_price AS hourlyPrice, nightly_price AS nightlyPrice FROM places WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, u.nickname, p.name, p.description, p.place_type AS placeType, p.allows_small_dog AS allowsSmallDog, p.allows_medium_dog AS allowsMediumDog, p.allows_large_dog AS allowsLargeDog, p.provides_home_camera AS providesHomeCamera, p.provides_realtime_photo AS providesRealtimePhoto, p.provides_yard AS providesYard, p.provides_walk AS providesWalk, p.hourly_price AS hourlyPrice FROM places p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.host_user_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.is_visible = TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT p.id, p.host_user_id AS hostUserId, u.nickname, p.name, p.description, p.place_type AS placeType, p.area_size AS areaSize, p.capacity, p.allows_small_dog AS allowsSmallDog, p.allows_medium_dog AS allowsMediumDog, p.allows_large_dog AS allowsLargeDog, p.provides_home_camera AS providesHomeCamera, p.provides_realtime_photo AS providesRealtimePhoto, p.provides_yard AS providesYard, p.provides_walk AS providesWalk, p.other_options AS otherOptions, p.hourly_price AS hourlyPrice, p.nightly_price AS nightlyPrice, p.status, p.is_visible AS visible FROM places p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.host_user_id WHERE p.id = #{placeId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
